Ein Klick zu viel, ein neues Home Assist: One click too many, a new Home Assistant or new hardware – your plan won't get lost.
In Teil 2 zeige ich dir Sicherung, Impor: In part 2 I show you backups, importing and moving.
Teil 1 hat alle Einstellungen gezeigt. J: Part 1 showed all the settings. Now it's about undo, restore points, the three kinds of files, moving and privacy.
Und zum Schluss ein paar Worte zum Ende: And at the end a few words to close this series.
Das Wichtigste zuerst: Verschiebst du au: First things first: if you move a room by accident …
… holt „Rückgängig“ oben in der Werkzeug: … Undo – „Rückgängig“ – at the top of the toolbar brings it back. Redo – „Wiederholen“ – does it again.
Schneller geht es mit Strg+Z – und mit g: It's quicker with Ctrl+Z – and holding Shift as well, you redo.
Das gilt für alles, was du gerade bearbe: That works for everything you are editing right now. For older states there are the restore points.
Die stehen ganz unten in der Seitenleist: They are at the very bottom of the sidebar, in the Backup section – „Sicherung“.
Beim Bearbeiten entsteht höchstens alle: While you edit, a restore point – „Wiederherstellungspunkt“ – is kept at most every 10 minutes, and the last 20 stay. Each row shows the time, the rooms and the furniture.
„Wiederherstellen“ holt einen Stand zurü: Restore – „Wiederherstellen“ – brings a state back, after asking you first. The current state is kept as a point itself, so you lose nothing.
Darunter „Datei“. „Exportieren“ speicher: Below that is File. Export – „Exportieren“ – saves the plan with all its links: rooms, furniture, devices and sensors.
Bilder sind nicht drin, das steht auch d: Pictures are not included, it says so below. For the pictures there is the full backup in a moment.
„Als Vorlage teilen“ lässt alles weg, wa: “Share as template” – „Als Vorlage teilen“ – leaves out everything that belongs to your Home Assistant: areas, devices, sensors and pictures.
Das ist die Datei für einen Freund, fürs: That's the file for a friend, for a forum or for a bug report – without your devices.
„Importieren …“ lädt so eine Datei. Ich: Import – „Importieren“ – loads such a file. I take the template from just now.
Vorher fragt NeonPlan nach: Der ganze Gr: NeonPlan asks first: the whole floor plan is replaced, and the current state stays as a restore point.
So sieht eine Vorlage aus: Räume, Wände,: This is what a template looks like: rooms, walls, doors and furniture are there – but no devices and no links.
Genau das passiert auch auf einem andere: The same happens on another Home Assistant: links go through the areas and entities. If they have the same names there, everything is connected right away.
Sonst wählst du je Raum den „Bereich“ ne: Otherwise you pick the area – „Bereich“ – again for each room, and its devices are back in the list.
Zurück zum alten Stand? Unter „Wiederher: Back to the old state? Under restore points there is now the point from just before the import.
„Wiederherstellen“ – und das Demo-Haus i: Restore – and the demo house is complete again, with all its devices.
Für alles auf einmal gibt es das „Komple: For everything at once there is the full backup – „Komplett-Backup“. “Back up everything” – „Alles sichern“ – saves the plan, every background and screen picture and the installed packs.
Der Lizenzschlüssel ist bewusst nicht in: The licence key is deliberately not in the file.
„Komplett-Backup wiederherstellen …“ spi: “Restore a full backup” – „Komplett-Backup wiederherstellen“ – plays it back, into the same or another installation. Here too NeonPlan asks first.
Jedes Pack wird dabei neu geprüft. Packs: Every pack is checked again. Packs signed for another installation are skipped – you get them again there through the shop.
Übrigens: Das normale Backup von Home As: By the way: the normal Home Assistant backup also saves NeonPlan 3D completely.
Jetzt der Umzug, zum Beispiel auf einen: Now moving, for example to a new mini PC. The easiest way is to restore your Home Assistant backup on the new hardware – then NeonPlan is there with everything.
Fängst du neu an, geht es in vier Schrit: If you start fresh, it takes four steps. One: on the old system, “Back up everything”.
Zweitens: Auf dem neuen System installie: Two: on the new system you install NeonPlan 3D through HACS, add the integration and create your areas.
Drittens: Im Editor unter „Sicherung“ da: Three: in the editor, under Backup, restore the full backup.
Die Meldung oben sagt, was zurückkam – u: The message at the top tells you what came back – and which pack was skipped because it is still signed for the old installation.
Viertens: Unter „Erweiterungen“ trägst d: Four: under Extensions – „Erweiterungen“ – you enter your licence key and press Activate – „Aktivieren“. I use an invented demo key.
Dann stehen deine Käufe da, und „Install: Then your purchases show up, and Install – „Installieren“ – fetches each pack again, signed for this installation.
Warum neu? Jedes Pack wird für genau ein: Why again? Every pack is signed for exactly one installation. The shop recognises it by the installation id – „Installations-Kennung“ – an anonymous fingerprint.
Ein Schlüssel gilt für bis zu drei Insta: One key works for up to three installations at the same time. If you connect a new one, the oldest drops out – up to five new connections are possible per year.
Auf dem alten System kannst du die Verbi: On the old system you can end the connection with Disconnect – „Trennen“. The installed packs stay there anyway.
Und was speichert NeonPlan wo? Plan, Bil: And what does NeonPlan store where? Plan, pictures and packs live in Home Assistant, in the .storage folder. None of it leaves your installation.
Ins Internet geht NeonPlan nur, wenn du: NeonPlan only goes online if you enter a licence key: then once a day to the shop, with the key and the anonymous id.
Kamerabilder, Verläufe und Zustände blei: Camera pictures, history and states stay in Home Assistant and are only shown in your browser.
Hakt etwas, steht in der Seitenleiste „H: If something goes wrong, the sidebar has Help and feedback: “Report a problem” – „Problem melden“ – opens an issue on GitHub, “Propose an idea” a discussion.
Und „Community auf Discord“ bringt dich: And “Community on Discord” takes you to the other NeonPlan users – there we help each other.
